headline: Nevish Line Leads Renewed Front-Line Movement
war_summary: The latest ledger puts Nevish Line at the head of the campaign, with 74 base events in 24 hours, six in the latest two-hour watch, and its holdings still divided five Warden to three Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains the other great furnace: 51 events, three fresh in two hours, and a fractured map of six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases. Marban Hollow has quickened since the last edition, registering two events in the latest two hours and 17 across the day; its eight bases are split three Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral. Linn Mercy has reached 16 events, including five in six hours, though its heaviest fighting has cooled from the preceding window; nine Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral base now stand recorded. Stlican Shelf shows three events, two of them fresh, amid accelerating casualty rates. Kuura Strand’s 19-event tally has gone quiet in the latest six hours, while Godcrofts has not added to its six-event record. The broad front remains unsettled, but movement is concentrated in a handful of divided regions.
